tool_input.command:
sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && printf '
--- package ---
' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '
--- README ---
' && sed -n '1,260p' README.md

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import { Session } from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++; signal.aborted; return 'unexpected';},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const session=new Session(host,{online:false}); const handle=session.subscribe('central',{networkMode:'online'}); session.unsubscribe(handle); session.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls!==0) throw new Error('offline orphan invoked queryFn after reconnect'); const resumed=session.subscribe('central',{networkMode:'online'}); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls!==1) throw new Error('new observer did not resume query'); session.unsubscribe(resumed); let finish; let activeCalls=0; const online=new Session({queryFn:()=>{activeCalls++; return new Promise(resolve=>{finish=resolve;});},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}},{online:true}); const active=online.subscribe('harbor'); online.unsubscribe(active); finish('cached'); await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve(); const snapshot=online.snapshot('harbor'); if(activeCalls!==1||snapshot.status!=='success'||snapshot.data!=='cached') throw new Error('unconsumed active work did not complete'); console.log('lifecycle checks passed');" && /runtime/node --check src/session.js && git diff --no-index -- /dev/null src/session.js >/dev/null || true

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import { Session } from './src/session.js'; const timers={schedule:fn=>fn()}; const tick=async()=>{await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();}; let calls=0; const cache=new Session({queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++; signal.aborted; return 'bad';},timers},{online:false}); const h=cache.subscribe('station'); cache.online(true); cache.unsubscribe(h); await tick(); if(calls) throw Error('queued offline initial request ran after final unsubscribe'); let resolve; let sharedCalls=0; const shared=new Session({queryFn:()=>{sharedCalls++;return new Promise(r=>resolve=r);},timers}); const first=shared.subscribe('junction'); const second=shared.subscribe('junction'); if(sharedCalls!==1) throw Error('observers did not share initial request'); shared.unsubscribe(first); resolve('arrived'); await tick(); if(shared.snapshot('junction').data!=='arrived') throw Error('unconsumed request did not populate cache'); shared.unsubscribe(second); console.log('orphan reconnect race and shared-fetch checks passed');" && /runtime/node --check src/session.js
